subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain recent unmentioned group image media for later mentioned turns, and if so under what retention, cleanup, and path-exposure limits?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible, but preserving media from messages that did not address the bot changes the privacy and local-retention boundary for group chats.

options.title: Approve bounded history media
options.body: Allow Telegram to retain a small recent local-image subset using the shared history media contract, with explicit TTL/cleanup and no prompt-visible full paths.

options.title: Keep text-only history
options.body: Leave unmentioned group media unavailable from later turns to avoid retaining media that was not directly addressed to the bot.

options.title: Gate retention behind config
options.body: Require an explicit Telegram group/topic opt-in before retaining unmentioned media, accepting added configuration and upgrade/documentation cost.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded history media
recommendation.body: Allow Telegram to retain a small recent local-image subset using the shared history media contract, with explicit TTL/cleanup and no prompt-visible full paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The current pre-download skip was introduced in PR 81785 and is the closest history signal for the privacy-motivated Telegram unmentioned-media boundary.
